description: The list of work type-specific parameter overrides, may be empty if only default parameters are being updated

description.description: The custom description for the field for this work type, null to use default or preserve current

isRequired.description: Whether the field is required for this work type, null to use default or preserve current

rendererType.description: The renderer type for the field for this work type, null to use default or preserve current

workTypeId.description: The ID of the work type (issue type) for which these parameters apply
